title: vochysia tucanorum var. elongata
intro: Vochysia tucanorum var. elongata, commonly known as Vochysia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Vochysiaceae. It is a tree native to the tropical regions of Central and South America, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Vochysia include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Vochysia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-microbial properties.
